skillFull: Plays the drums at certain intervals. While playing, the Jump and Slide buttons are changed to Drum buttons. Play the drums following the notes approaching in the center of the screen to get points. Notes with numbers must be tapped that number of times in a certain amount of time to earn points. Level up to earn more Drum Points.
story:
Rat-a-tat, ba-dum tsss! As a tiny Cookie, Strawberry Stick Cookie was drumming before writing. The sweet-but-sour beat of strawberry cream-dipped biscuit sticks matches that of the hypest drums.

With a natural sense of rhythm and a penchant for practice, this Cookie is notorious for scribbling down beats and melodies in her class notebooks and breaking a chocolate biscuit stick or two.

It may be true that drumming lets out stress, because Strawberry Stick Cookie's positive outlook on life, ringing bright and clear as a hi-hat, lets her get over any hardship with a smile as she looks forward to the next beat she'll drum up.
